description: Power analyzers (DMG7000, DMG7500, DMG8000, DMG9000) and EXS4 current measuring modules: voltages, currents, powers, power factors, THD, harmonics, min/max/average/demand values, energies by tariff and phase, power quality statistics, I/O status and commands
source: Lovato Electric, DMG7000-7500-8000-9000 / EXS4… Modbus manual, I676 GB PL 03 22

sources.title: Power analyzers DMG7000-7500-8000-9000, EXS4000-EXS4001 – Modbus manual

notes: Modbus RTU, ASCII or TCP (one TCP connection per port). Functions 03 and 04 read, 06 and 16 write; up to 120 registers per request. Big endian, high word first.
Addresses are those of the manual; the address sent in the request is one less (address_base 1), as the manual's examples show (menu selection 0x5000 is written to 0x4FFF).
The model is reported by function 17 (Report Slave ID): 0x70 DMG7000, 0x75 DMG7500, 0x80 DMG8000, 0x90 DMG9000, 0x40 EXS4.
Setup parameters are reached through the parameter access registers: write the menu, submenu and parameter numbers, then read or write the value, and save with 5 to 0x2F03.
Not in this map: the 40-bit alarm, PLC, limit and remote variable status words (three registers each at 0x2120, 0x2130, 0x2140 and 0x4F00) and the Easy Branch and EXS4 channel blocks.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
